eyebrow: Azure Databricks & Delta Lake · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 22 · Delta Lake

code:
UPDATE trips SET fare_amount = 0 WHERE fare_amount < 0;

DELETE FROM trips WHERE trip_distance IS NULL;
caption: Plain Parquet has no safe way to do this -- Delta can, via more commits (Lesson 17's mechanism, at work).

code:
MERGE INTO trips AS target
USING new_trips AS source
ON target.trip_id = source.trip_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET *
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *
caption: Update matching rows, insert new ones -- atomically, in one statement.

code:
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

target = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, "/data/nyc_taxi/delta/trips")
target.alias("target").merge(
  new_trips.alias("source"), "target.trip_id = source.trip_id"
).whenMatchedUpdateAll().whenNotMatchedInsertAll().execute()
caption: delta.tables -- genuinely new, since Foundations never wrote to a Delta table.
